purpose: Save an attached image, video, or ZIP archive as a private Bytes artifact.

positive: Using Bytes, save this attached video to my workspace.
Using Bytes, save this ZIP archive to my workspace.
negative: Edit this video and add captions.
Tell me how to upload a video.
natural_language.ambiguity_question: Which image, video, or ZIP archive should I save to Bytes?

file.question: Please attach the image, video, or ZIP archive you want saved.
file.applies_when: When no attachment is available as an MCP file input.

title.question: What title should I use? I can use the filename.
title.applies_when: When no useful title is supplied by the request or filename.

outputs.when: After a supported image has been fully transferred and verified.
quality_checks: The file signature, size and SHA-256 match the transferred bytes.

outputs.when: After a supported video has been fully transferred and verified.
quality_checks: The file signature, size and SHA-256 match the transferred bytes.

outputs.when: After a ZIP archive has been fully transferred and verified.
quality_checks: The ZIP signature, size and SHA-256 match the transferred bytes.
The archive remains opaque and is not extracted.

capabilities.unavailable: Ask the user to attach the file or provide the signed-in Bytes web uploader link.

quality_checks: The result is a regular private image, video, or downloadable file artifact with a real pointer.
Report failed or unsupported file handoffs clearly; never claim an unsaved upload succeeded.
parameter_rules: Use an available attachment only; do not fetch arbitrary URLs as files.
Use the filename as title when useful; the user may explicitly override it.
